title: Sinnoh jogável — piloto Twinleaf a Sandgem
phase_count_policy: J01 and J02 count executable engineering code with CI, not installed maps or native gameplay. J02 has 4 audited historical terrain references and 5 missing real maps; no approved 9/9 local bindings. Physical/native proof remains 0/8; L phases never count.

stages.title: Verificar instalação real e fonte de mapas
stages.completion_requires: Preflight runnable, fail-closed checks and regression CI pass; local real baseline still pending

stages.title: Reservar MapIDs e vincular os 9 mapas do piloto
stages.completion_requires: J02 executable 9-map source-to-destination validator and audited 4/9 historical terrain reference catalog complete; requires five new real maps, local game/Data, reservations R07 and rights R08 before any native binding or installation.

stages.title: Converter terrenos e tilesets para cópia isolada
stages.completion_requires: Authorized real tiles/geometry staged and verified without touching main game

stages.title: Compilar 16 portais, 5 NPCs e 3 Poké Bolas
stages.completion_requires: All 16 warps, five handlers and three physical balls compiled with real coordinates and sprites

stages.title: Integrar Barry, regras de batalha e save Sinnoh
stages.completion_requires: Barry teams compiled; starter, battle and isolated save/reload pass in copy

stages.title: Preparar instalador/launcher Windows do piloto
stages.completion_requires: User can launch isolated Windows pilot without modifying main install or saves

stages.title: Validar Windows, saves e regressões multirregionais
stages.completion_requires: Windows native QA and regional/save regressions reviewed

stages.title: Preparar, testar e distribuir piloto Android/JoiPlay
stages.completion_requires: Android/JoiPlay QA on isolated test package and safe incremental release

blockers: Quatro mapas exteriores de fonte conhecida têm somente metadados e SHA; arquivos RXDATA/PNG não estão na main autorizados
Cinco mapas não possuem terreno não vazio validado: quarto, casa 1F, casa Barry, Lago Verity e laboratório Rowan
Instalação game/Data e reservas futuras de MapIDs R07 ainda não homologadas
Licenças individuais R08 pendentes; nenhum mapa instalado ou evento compilado
43 testes Windows e 1 Android ainda não executados
